title: The Landing
intro: Enjoy a relaxed dining experience at The Landing, an all ranks club offering a beautiful waterfront view—perfect for both casual lunches and memorable events.

sections.heading: About The Landing
sections.markdown: Join us for weekday lunch service, featuring an à la carte menu with fresh, satisfying options for every taste. Whether you're planning a special occasion or just grabbing a midday bite, The Landing is your go-to spot for great food and great views.

sections.heading: The Landing Lunch Menu
sections.markdown:
Choose from a variety of freshly prepared dishes, each priced individually so you can mix and match to your taste. From hearty mains to lighter sides, and fresh salads, our à la carte menu offers flexibility and flavor in every bite.

Any burger or sandwich can also be made into a wrap.

Add Guacamole to any entrée: $1

**Landing Burger** - $13
6oz. steak burger served with beer cheese, green leaf lettuce, tomato, red onion, and pickle on a brioche bun

**Rueben Sandwich** - $12
A warm corned beef and Swiss sandwich with sauerkraut and thousand island dressing on marble rye

**Chicken Bacon Ranch Sandwich** - $13
6oz. chicken breast served with green leaf lettuce, tomato, red onion, and pickle on a brioche bun

**Philly Cheesesteak** - $12
Thinly sliced sirloin with peppers and sliced red onion topped with cheese sauce on a hoagie roll

**Chicken Philly** - $12
Thinly sliced chicken breast with peppers and red onion topped with cheese sauce on a hoagie roll

**Protein Bowl** - $13
Rice, black beans, corn, cheese, lettuce, sour cream, fire roasted salsa and your choice of protein:
• Chicken
• Steak
• Pork
• Battered Shrimp

**Carnitas Tacos** - $13
Carnitas style pork tacos served on corn tortillas with slaw, pickled red onion, and chipotle adobo aioli

**Chicken Wings** - $13
Fried chicken wings served with your choice of sauce – buffalo, honey butter garlic sauce, BBQ sauce, Thai sweet chili, or Nashville hot

**Spicy Shrimp Po 'boy** - $13
Battered shrimp served with green leaf lettuce, tomato, onion, and remoulade on a hoagie roll

**Quesadilla** - $12
Flour tortilla stuffed with cheese your choice of protein mixed with bell peppers and onions with a side of sour cream/fire roasted salsa:
• Chicken
• Steak
• Pork
• Shrimp

**Entree Salad** - $12
A large salad topped with carrots, cucumber, tomato, cheese, pickled onions, and croutons served with choice of protein and dressing:
• Chicken and bacon
• Steak
• Pork
• Battered Shrimp

**Nashville Hot Chicken Sandwich** - $12
Grilled or fried chicken tossed in Nashville hot sauce with pickles

**Sides:** onion rings, sweet potato fries (salt or cinnamon sugar), natural cut fries, or side salad

**Side Salad** - $6
Green leaf lettuce, tomato, red onion, shredded carrot, and crouton

**Salad Dressing:** Ranch, Italian, Blue Cheese, Balsamic Vinaigrette, Caesar, Awesome Sauce

**Beverages** - $2.50
Free refills. Choice of Coke, Coke Zero, Mr. Pibb, Sprite, Pink Lemonade, Powerade, Sweet or Unsweet Tea
